# Suede Audit

> Suede Audit is a public-site audit for crawler access, entity schema, metadata, content structure, and answer-engine discovery signals.

## Primary URL

- Product: https://optimize.suedeai.ai/
- Source: https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-scan
- Implementation service: https://seo.suedeai.ai/
- Suede AI: https://suedeai.ai/

## Method

The automated report fetches a public homepage, robots.txt, llms.txt, and sitemap.xml. It scores weighted checks and names a repair for every failed signal.

Search-discovery checks use OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, and Googlebot. GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and Google-Extended are reported separately as non-scoring training or AI-use controls.

Each browser receives one free audit. The result is cached in that browser so its report route can reopen without another scan.

The readiness score measures whether answer engines can reach, parse and quote a site's pages, the groundwork every citation depends on. Citation evidence comes from buyer-question runs inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and the other answer engines; the AI citation check at https://seo.suedeai.ai/ai-citation-check runs them and records the cited sources.

## Check reference

- [Check reference](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/checks): All 28 weighted checks with severity, points, pass rule and repair; 90 points in total.
- [Page access and indexing](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/checks/page-access): HTTP status, HTTPS, noindex, canonical, viewport, html lang and HTML weight.
- [Crawler access](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/checks/crawler-access): How robots.txt is read for OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot; GPTBot, ClaudeBot and Google-Extended are reported without scoring.
- [Discovery files](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/checks/discovery-files): When /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml and /llms.txt pass.
- [Structured data and entity](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/checks/structured-data): Valid JSON-LD, a primary Organization, Corporation, LocalBusiness, OnlineBusiness or Person type, and sameAs.
- [Titles, descriptions and share metadata](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/checks/metadata): Title 15 to 60 characters, description 50 to 160, Open Graph, twitter:card and favicon.
- [Headings, content and links](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/checks/content-structure): One H1, two or more H2, 300 words, three internal links and image alt attributes.
- [Retrieval chunk size](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/checks/retrieval-chunks): Every heading section must hold 375 words or fewer, about one 500-token retrieval chunk.

## Notes from Suede AI

- [Notes](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/notes): Articles by Jason Colapietro, founder of Suede AI in West Palm Beach, Florida, on AI readiness for Palm Beach County businesses.
- [What an AI readiness score measures, and what it can't](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/notes/what-an-ai-readiness-score-measures): What the 28 weighted checks read, the three questions behind the number, what no outside audit can observe, and how to order repairs by points.
- [The five fixes we make first on West Palm Beach and Jupiter business websites](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/notes/five-website-fixes-west-palm-beach-jupiter): The order Suede AI repairs a local site in: open the door to search crawlers, say who you are in schema, fix titles, put copy in the HTML, and keep sections short.
- [How Suede AI SEO ranked #1 among Palm Beach County companies on The Manifest, and what it means](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/notes/manifest-palm-beach-county-ai-deployment-ranking): The date, category and geography behind the ranking, how to check it yourself, why third-party listings feed entity evidence, and how to weigh any agency ranking.

## Source and citation guide

- [AI Instructions](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/ai-instructions): Site identity, authoritative sources and citation guidance.
- [Full text](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/llms-full.txt): the readable text of every page above in one file, generated from the pages themselves.
